component.name: PrivilegedBridge
component.summary: Controlled access to approved privileged Linux operations

description.p: PrivilegedBridge provides an allowlisted command-line interface between local AI agents and approved Linux system operations.
Rather than giving an AI agent an unrestricted privileged shell, PrivilegedBridge exposes predefined actions and reports their results through a local command-line interface.
Initial public PrivilegedBridge release with an allowlisted local AI system-operation interface.
